Belonging to a celebrated Ragamala suite, the painting personifies the classical Indian musical mode of Hindola (associated with the playful, romantic swing festival of spring). A handsome young prince, clad in an elegant pointed Deccani jama with a long sash (patka), sits serenely upon an ornate golden swing (hindola) suspended from a blossoming tree.
